assumptions: This is not an official DeepSeek training deployment or a performance prediction.

DP denotes independent complete replicas. Each replica has PP4 and EP2 with TP1; world=16. EP partitions the two samples/tokens inside each local microbatch; it does not multiply the logical MB count.

Dense weights are replicated across DP and EP coordinates; routed expert weights are sharded by EP and replicated across DP. Optimizer states are reference-shaped shards inside each gradient collective group.
Only L2 has representative operator events. Other layers and the output/MTP/loss head are coarse context blocks, not full-layer or kernel traces. This is a lightweight visual demo.
Synthetic role weights, EP/PP times and absolute ms scale are illustrative. Only the aggregate backward/forward duration ratio is derived from ST; ST stage imbalance is not transplanted.

One serial compute resource per rank, explicit EP/PP communication dependencies and no activation recomputation. The reduce-scatter, clip, optimizer and parameter-all-gather lifecycle follows ST event categories, while parameter groups, shard ownership and durations are simulated rather than claimed as an official DeepSeek deployment.
